Title: How to Caulk Exterior Windows (and Stop Drafts): The Quick Answer
Description: To caulk exterior windows, pick a dry day above 40°F and an exterior-grade sealant. Remove the old, failing caulk, clean the joint, and fill deep gaps with backer rod. Run a steady bead where the trim meets the siding, but leave the weep holes at the bottom open so water can drain. Full guide with every step on Home Improvement Hub.

Title: How to Clean Refrigerator Coils: The Quick Answer
Description: To clean refrigerator coils, unplug the refrigerator and find the coils, either behind the bottom grille or on the back. Brush the dust loose with a coil brush, vacuum it up, then replace the grille and plug the fridge back in. Do this every 6–12 months, more often with pets. Title: How to Replace a Kitchen Faucet (Step by Step): The Quick Answer
Description: To replace a kitchen faucet, count the sink holes and buy a faucet that fits, then shut off the water and relieve the pressure. Disconnect and remove the old faucet, mount the new one, and connect the supply lines. Remove the aerator, flush the lines, and check for leaks. Full guide with every step on Home Improvement Hub.

Title: How to Seal Grout in a Shower or Bathroom Floor: The Quick Answer
Description: To seal grout, wait at least 48–72 hours after new grout is installed, or deep-clean old grout and let it dry completely. Apply a penetrating grout sealer to the joints only, wipe any excess off the tile, and let it cure. A drop of water that beads up means the seal worked. Title: How to Fix a Running Toilet: The Quick Answer
Description: To fix a running toilet, first find the leak: put food coloring in the tank and wait 15 minutes. Color in the bowl means a worn flapper. Otherwise check the water level and chain. Adjust the chain, replace the flapper, or replace the fill valve if water keeps running into the overflow tube. Full guide with every step on Home Improvement Hub.

Title: How to Weatherstrip an Exterior Door: The Quick Answer
Description: To weatherstrip a door, find the drafts with a candle or by looking for daylight, identify your strip type, and remove the old strip. Install new weatherstrip on the head first, then the sides, seal the bottom with a sweep or threshold gasket, and check that the door still closes and latches easily. Title: How to Install Quarter Round Molding: The Quick Answer
Description: To install quarter round, prime and paint the stock first, then measure each wall. Cope or miter the inside corners and miter the outside corners. Nail it to the baseboard, not the floor, so a floating floor can still move. Finish by filling the nail holes, caulking and touching up the paint. Full guide with every step on Home Improvement Hub.

Title: How to Clean Your Gutters Safely: The Quick Answer
Description: To clean gutters, set the ladder at a 4-to-1 angle on firm ground, scoop the debris out by hand, and flush each run with a hose toward the downspout. Clear any clogged downspouts, then check the hangers, seams and fascia for damage. Plan on cleaning them at least twice a year. Full guide with every step on Home Improvement Hub.
